rules.scope: These eight ordinary spells only; inherits ordinary casting/Ready rather than a new generic transaction.
rules.text: Use the exact actual classAccess row, acquired repertoire, rank gate and chosen casting class. All eight are Action, 60-foot range and V/S/F; Greater Stoneflesh/Formlock cost rank4 7RP, Ironskin Legion/Petrify Limb rank5 10RP, the four rank6 spells 13RP. Existing class cost, armor surcharge, Dissonance/Refrain and current source modifications remain actual, not waived by these printed bases. Known illegality rejects before payment. At a legal direct commitment fix the declared target identities, mode, score/limb/role, actual geometry and item dispositions before the counter window; spend the actual Action/resources/components, ordinary history and concentration transition once. Prospective concentration displaces the prior source at commitment even if the new effect later fails. Resolve genuine cast interruption, then revalidate and resolve each selected recipient without post-result substitution, refund or another cast. For ordinary Ready, preparation fixes spell and mode/score/limb-role intent and pays once, while actual legal recipient/limb identity, target point and resulting geometry/item snapshots are selected at legal release under the existing Ready contract. A preparation cannot name an unowned action or extend Ready past next regular own START. No second counter window, RP, history or class trigger at release. A one-recipient limb requires a then-present eligible part of the released target; the declared role is not switched after hidden eligibility or saves. All links inherit actual original caster, class/rank, DC, source/use ID and legitimate counter/suppression/Null facts. Unobserved failure does not disclose a special immunity reason or hidden roster.

rules.scope: Eight-spell source clocks, ending saves and lifecycle; no new global scheduler.
rules.text: Sixty-second effects run from successful establishment, not prospective concentration; Wind Walk runs 3600 elapsed seconds; Flesh to Stone has no timed endpoint. Expiry wins over any same-time upkeep, resumption or repeat opportunity and consumes its endpoint once. Suppression never pauses any clock or queues missed benefits, healing, movement or commands. Genuine recipient END saves for Petrify Limb continue while its expression is suppressed or its part is temporarily unmatched. Use the recipient's actual regular END, including an underway eligible END after admission; extra turns do not supply additional regular-END saves. For an actually owner-attached creature use its genuine attached-phase END; if that regular owner turn supplies no execution phase, use that owner's real END for a spell-ending save only. This fallback is NEW and only for Petrify Limb; it grants no body, owner, Action or command. Persist source/recipient/real-turn marker receipts across controller or schedule changes. If genuinely outside initiative with no actual recurring phase, make a spell-ending-only CON save after each completed six-second interval anchored to admission; entering a real schedule cancels the competing virtual endpoint and uses only future real ENDs, without replaying any prior elapsed interval. Actual encounter/schedule transitions are director/world events, not an actor-selected resource reset. Death and source expiry are processed before any endpoint save. A success permanently ends the source; later suppression exit does not reapply it.

rules.scope: Actual body, gear, part and placement records; not new creature profiles.
rules.text: Use one real creature identity, HP account, anatomy and custody. Maintain original body-part IDs with explicit correspondence across actual forms; an appearance, name, class level or bestiary comparison is not that correspondence. Keep base body weight separate from gear, melded contents and condition multipliers. Follow the complete accepted body/form rules: voluntary space/gear preflight; forced reconciliation without cargo immunity; fixed continuous meld-chain pound and Load ceilings; unavailable melded gear during suppression; no repair/refill/cargo recapture from resumption; same-anchor, legitimate squeeze, then nearest legal adjacent placement in the same unobstructed region, otherwise pending placement. Nothing here grants Huge/Gargantuan dimensions, injury/severing permission, new hands, unknown support strength or an anatomy profile. An existing negative source must be ended/replaced through its own timing. Actual world clocks, harm, ownership, losses and original deadlines remain through every body change. Formlock's category selection, Flesh to Stone's persistence and Earthstep's explicit reverse-route exception below are limited local exceptions, not rewrites of every transformation.

rules.scope: Only the defense/score components expressly given by these spells.
rules.text: Calculate the actual compatible armor/form formula, then strongest applicable spell-family flat AC. Smaller independent sources can keep their separate riders and reappear when the stronger source is absent; suppressed sources are not active. Resistance halves each eligible component once, rounding down; immunity/vulnerability and actual same-stat defenses retain their scope. Magical provenance and typed B/P/S are different tests. Generic resistance never supplies the explicit Corruption protection required by Core. There is no automatic quartering, new damage root from prevention, resource recovery, armor material/proficiency, or object durability. Capacity changes recalculate from their real holders and clamp current balances only as that holder says. A maximum increase is not healing; a downward HP clamp is not damage, sacrifice, Wounds, concentration or death-save failure. Recompute derived thresholds without reviving or resetting actual life/Stable records.

rules.scope: Finite source ownership and callbacks; not a production persistence implementation.
rules.text: Persist commitment IDs, paid wallets, original deadlines, current expression, source family, recipient/link/part identities, hard-denial history, END-save markers, custody/drop/placement transitions and terminal receipts. Mark a terminal or actual work item consumed before its callbacks. Repeated delivery does not recast, save, give another move, re-drop equipment, return lost material or end concentration twice. A failed save that is blocked by actual immunity does not admit a hard denial. Flesh to Stone spends the actual source-character/recipient/encounter whole-Action-denial allowance only on establishment; no source below erases that history. Petrify Limb and Formlock do not themselves claim whole-Action denial. Full state serialization here is authored evidence, not implemented atomic persistence or campaign authentication.
